items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Kildee, you mean? No, Herman Franklin. Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. He told me he played with Jimmy Gunn and they recorded one of his tunes to my levy home.
I've been hunting for that record ever since. Kildee, you mean? No, Herman Franklin. Oh, yeah.
He worked with Celestan, I don't know if they didn't record.
